observation.visible_scene: A white ceramic mug with a black handle sits on a light wooden tabletop, backlit by a bright blurred window. The mug is filled with a hot beverage, and a plume of white steam rises continuously from its rim against a soft-focus background of orange-and-white tiled wall.
visible_changes: The steam plume above the mug is in constant turbulent motion, shifting shape and direction from frame to frame rather than moving as a rigid body.

Early frames (t=0.0–0.4) show a broad, billowing steam mass drifting toward the upper right; mid frames (t=0.8–1.1) show a distinct swirling loop/ring forming in the steam; later frames (t=1.6–2.6) show the steam narrowing into a more vertical, wispy column that leans slightly left.
The mug, its black handle, and its position on the table remain stationary throughout the excerpt; the background window and table edge also stay fixed, indicating no camera movement.
Steam density and brightness vary as it rises and dissipates, but a continuous emission from the rim is maintained across the whole segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the steam (e.g., freshly poured liquid, heating) and any events before t=0.0 or after t=2.67 are not shown.
Whether the steam eventually stops or the mug is moved is unknown, as the segment ends mid-process.
uncertain_details: The exact internal airflow pattern of the steam is turbulent and hard to track frame-by-frame; descriptions of loop formation are approximate.
Minor apparent shifts in steam position could be partly due to depth-of-field blur rather than true lateral translation.
